newsitem.title: POLAND: IBCA gives Polish Investment Bank BBB- rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA gives Polish Investment Bank BBB- rating.

text.p: IBCA gave the Polish Investment Bank SA (PBI) its first rating, a BBB- long-term and a B short-term rating, the bank said in a statement on Thursday.
It said IBCA also gave the state-owned PBI a C individual rating and a 2 legal rating.
"In our opinion the high rating takes into account the position of the (PBI) bank on the market, its quick growth and its high security," the statement said.
PBI, which was carved out of the National Bank of Poland in May of 1993 remains 100-percent owned by the central bank and is earmarked for privatisation early in 1997.
IBCA last gave Poland a long-term rating of BBB and a short-term rating of A3.
